data.title: 和栗薰子 · 雨檐下慢慢变暖的双手
data.description: 放学后遇雨，薰子穿整齐的校园制服坐在店铺屋檐下，用双手抱住一杯热可可。她拢好黑紫色发丝，看看雨滴沿伞尖落下，蓝眼里的神情渐渐安定；书包和合拢的伞都靠在身旁。
data.action: 双手捧住热可可，看着伞尖滴落的雨水渐渐放松。
data.promptProse: Kaoruko Waguri sits beneath the shop eaves after school, wrapping both hands around a hot cocoa cup while watching drops fall from her closed umbrella's tip. Her Kikyo uniform remains neat as she settles stray blackish-purple hair, bookbag beside her. The medium view includes the sheltered bench and wet lane beyond. Reflected shop light softly illuminates her calmer blue eyes and white collar, with dimmer rainwater reflections outside the shelter.
